examples.en: The hotel check-in starts at three in the afternoon every day.
examples.zh: 飯店每天下午三點開始辦理入住。

examples.en: Long check-ins at the airport can make travelers feel tired.
examples.zh: 機場冗長的報到手續會讓旅客覺得疲累。

examples.en: Check-in for the school trip closes at seven in the morning.
examples.zh: 校外教學的報到在早上七點截止。

_case: 連字號詞：原形、複數、句首大寫

examples.en: Our English class begins at eight o'clock on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 我們的英文課在星期一早上八點開始。

examples.en: The last bus leaves the station at ten o’clock tonight.
examples.zh: 最後一班公車今晚十點離站。

examples.en: It was already five o'clock when the store finally closed.
examples.zh: 商店終於打烊時已經五點了。

examples.en: Excuse me, ma'am, you dropped your scarf near the door.
examples.zh: 女士，不好意思，您的圍巾掉在門邊了。

examples.en: Yes, ma’am, I will bring the menu right away.
examples.zh: 是的，女士，我馬上拿菜單來。

examples.en: The student politely said, "Thank you, ma'am," to the teacher.
examples.zh: 那位學生有禮貌地對老師說：「謝謝您，老師。」

_case: 撇號詞：直引號、彎引號、後接標點

examples.en: The doctor asked him to take an X-ray of his left arm.
examples.zh: 醫生要他照一張左手臂的 X 光片。

examples.en: The X-rays showed that her leg was not broken.
examples.zh: X 光片顯示她的腿沒有骨折。

examples.en: Every hospital in the city has a new x-ray machine.
examples.zh: 這座城市的每家醫院都有新的 X 光機。

_case: an X-ray（正確用法，X 唸 eks）、複數、小寫
_expect: 無 WARN（舊 check_extra 預期誤報 an x）

examples.en: Please send me an e-mail when you arrive at the hotel.
examples.zh: 你抵達飯店時，請寄一封電子郵件給我。

examples.en: She reads her e-mails before the first meeting every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上開第一場會議前都會看電子郵件。

examples.en: The teacher sent the e-mail to all the parents yesterday.
examples.zh: 老師昨天把這封電子郵件寄給所有家長。

_case: 含單字母前綴的連字號詞；an e-mail 正確

examples.en: Our team was the runner-up in the school basketball contest.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍是學校籃球賽的亞軍。

examples.en: The two runners-up each received a small silver cup.
examples.zh: 兩位亞軍各獲得一座小銀盃。

examples.en: Being the runner-up made her work even harder next year.
examples.zh: 拿到亞軍讓她明年更加努力。

_case: 不規則複數 runners-up（複數詞綴在第一部分）
_expect: 無 WARN（舊 check_batch 預期誤報 runners-up）

examples.en: There is always a trade-off between price and quality when shopping.
examples.zh: 購物時，價格和品質之間總是需要取捨。

examples.en: The trade-offs of living downtown include noise and higher rent.
examples.zh: 住在市中心的取捨包括噪音和較高的租金。

examples.en: We accepted the trade-off and chose the cheaper hotel room.
examples.zh: 我們接受這個取捨，選了比較便宜的飯店房間。

examples.en: Our class won the tug-of-war on sports day last Friday.
examples.zh: 我們班在上週五的運動會上贏得拔河比賽。

examples.en: The tug-of-war rope was so heavy that two boys could not lift it.
examples.zh: 拔河的繩子太重，兩個男生都抬不起來。

examples.en: Many students joined the tug-of-war after the long lunch break.
examples.zh: 午休結束後，許多學生參加了拔河。
